notes.subject: לבער קין
notes.rationale: Sampela i ritim 'Kain bai i bagarap' (lamed-bet-ayin-resh: swaswa), sampela YLT i ritim 'Kenite bai i paia' — glosa i hambak

notes.subject: עד מה
notes.rationale: KJV: 'inanap long taim Asshur i tekim yu', JPS: 'Wanem taim? Ashur bai i tekim yu kalabus' — askim o wanpela stori

notes.subject: קין
notes.rationale: Hibru i raitim קַיִן (Qayin/Kain) hia — nem bilong lain, i no wankain olsem Keni long ves 21

translation: Tasol sapos Bain i swaswa Pinis, Kon inap i stap? Ashur bai ol i kalapim yu na ol i tekim yu kalabus.

tokens.gloss: bai ol i tekim yu kalabus
